name: How long does ceramic tile installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does ceramic tile installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on room size, prep needs, and cure times. Even a small project may take more than one day because mortar and grout need drying time, and larger or more complex jobs can take several days.
acceptedAnswer.description: A small tile job may take a day or two, but prep and curing often add time. Larger rooms, repairs, or waterproofing can extend the schedule.
